items.text: Can name and describe all five EC2 pricing models
Understand why AWS offers multiple pricing models instead of one
Know the exact discount percentages: Spot (90%), Reserved (72%), Savings Plans (66–72%)
Understand the difference between Standard RI and Convertible RI
Understand the difference between Dedicated Instance and Dedicated Host
Know what BYOL means and which pricing model supports it
Understand how Spot price fluctuation and the 2-minute warning work
Can use the AWS Pricing Calculator to compare EC2 pricing models
Can view Spot Instance price history in the AWS Console
Can explain the mixed fleet strategy and when to apply it
Can choose the correct pricing model for a given workload scenario
Can calculate approximate annual savings by switching from On-Demand to Reserved
Can answer: Which model gives the highest discount? (Spot — 90%)
Can answer: Which RI type can change instance family? (Convertible RI)
Can answer: Which RI type provides a capacity reservation? (Zonal RI)
Can distinguish Dedicated Instance vs Dedicated Host in exam scenarios
